text.text_excerpt: Okay this place is great due to their selection of beers on tap. I love having a huge variety of beers to choose from from all around the country and world. They also have a 2 for 1 special. As a few other yelpers have mentioned, that means you buy one beer for yourself and you get one free no matter if you have another person in your party or not. Our bartender was very nice and had no problem striking up a conversation with her. The bathroom is gross here and you might have to worry about catching something.

Restrooms for customers only (if you like stalls without doors, then this is the bathroom for you!). Pretty amazing beer selection, actually. Bartender was adamant that they didn't have any sour beers, and then I pointed out there was a Berlinerweisse and she was like "oh yeah." Something for everyone. Probably best as a pit stop to grab a beer (that doesn't suck) to drink on Bourbon.

This place should not be called Beer Fest. This place should be called BEER UTOPIA ! There is more beer, ale, stout, bock, IPA, pilsners, lagers, cream ales, Belgian styles, weizens, and the like that you can drink in one night or many nights or days or weeks. If you don' t like this type of thing then don't come. If you are interested in learning about this type of thing and trying something new then you will not find a better place. This is Bourbon Street so things are a little pricey at 10 bucks a pop. But the serving sizes are generous and the bartenders are very knowledgeable of the product they sell.
